notes.title: Update 2.0 - Gadget Update
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce the first large TTOC update. There will be more on the way soon! You can request new features in the community hub.

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]

[b]CONSUMABLE ITEMS[/b]

The power-up shop has been replaced with a consumables shop. At the moment, there are 4 consumables you can buy:

Medkit - Heals HP.
Shield Plasma - Recovers armor.
Mine - Deals damage when stepped on by an enemy.
Turret - Will shoot at enemies and can be recharged by hitting it.

You can hold a maximum 5 of each.

[b]NEW DUNGEON ELEMENTS[/b]

You can now find dead soldiers around dungeons, that carry extra loot.

New types of plants have been added:

Ice zone: snow covered grass, snowdrops and crocuses.
Desert zone: Different types of cacti and desert grass.

[b]SMALLER TWEAKS[/b]

New sound added for picking up health and shields.
New particles added.
Balancing changes.

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]

Fixed bugs with level generation - no more doors that lead to nowhere and caused you to fall out of bounds.
Minor bug fixes.

I hope you'll enjoy the new features! Make sure to leave feedback if you can on the community hub!
